title: ClawHive Deck Studio Outline
description: The editable story of a deck. ClawHive renders and edits this file; clawhive-pptx projects it into design_spec.md §IX verbatim.

source.description: Who last wrote this file. The client page writes 'user'.

workMode.description: Where the outline comes from and which pages get rewritten. create = from scratch; beautify = 1:1 from an existing deck, verbatim; edit = existing deck plus marked changes.

sourceSlideCount.description: beautify only: slide count of the source deck. The outline must match it exactly.

editScope.description: edit only: ids of the pages that change. Must match the slides marked changed.

primaryLanguage.description: Canonical BCP-47 with script or region. 'zh-CN', never 'zh'.

scene.description: Product-level scene preset. Canonical values: 通用汇报 / 竞品调研 / 销售汇报 / 客户方案 / 行业洞察 / 经营复盘 / 培训赋能 / 产品发布 / 客户案例. Old labels (工作汇报, 方案提案, 研究分析, 培训讲解, 发布介绍) are normalized to them. A scene fills contract defaults and suggests a mode; it never locks mode or readingMode.

contentDivergence.description: Free text: how far the deck may reshape the source. Blank means balanced.

mode.description: Narrative skeleton, one per deck. The scene preset recommends one; the agent may override when the communication intent or audience outcome calls for a different argument strategy.

readingMode.description: How the deck carries information. text = read without a presenter (reports, reviews, research); balanced = business review with a presenter; presentation = stage/launch. When omitted, the scene preset supplies the default. An explicit value wins, but the checker warns when it differs from the scene default.

pageBudget.description: Optional product-level length hint: compact 5–8 pages, standard 9–15, detailed 16–24. It is a hint, not a hard gate; the engine still treats page count as the user's call.

densityDefault.description: Drafting default used for pages that do not set their own density.

themeId.description: Chosen up front, applied as a visual overlay only after §IX is locked.

speakerNotes.description: Whether speaker notes are part of the deliverable. The projection writes this into §I; keep §X consistent.

id.description: Stable across reordering. Page numbers are derived, never stored.

role.description: cover = title page; toc = table of contents; section = chapter divider; hero = single-message impact page (projects to content with a hero moment); content = regular page; ending = closing.

points.description: What the page actually says. Each item is a full claim or short paragraph, not a keyword; long strings are allowed. This is the user's content, not the agent's.

evidence.description: The facts, numbers, quotes or observations that support the page's claims. One item per piece of evidence.

soWhat.description: What the evidence means for the reader: the implication, tension or judgment. Not a restatement of the claim.

action.description: What the audience should do next because of this page, when the page asks for a decision or action.

source.description: Visible provenance line: source, date and definition/measurement basis. Every quantitative page should carry one.

relationships.description: Optional semantic units and how they relate; 'none' when the page has no relationship to draw.

composition.description: Optional macro composition direction. Non-binding: the executor may adapt or replace it.

density.description: How much this page carries. Drives the drafting length, not the type size.

rhythm.description: Derived from role and density. Written to spec_lock.md page_rhythm.

changed.description: edit only: true when this page is rewritten. Unchanged pages keep the source deck.

changeNote.description: edit only: what changes on this page and why. Required on every changed page.
